title: Reformat Phone Number
summary: Given a phone number as a string with digits, spaces, and dashes, remove all spaces and dashes.
statement: Given a phone number as a string with digits, spaces, and dashes, remove all spaces and dashes. Then, group the digits into blocks of three from left to right. If the final group has four digits, split it into two blocks of two. Join the blocks with dashes, ensuring no single-digit blocks and at most two two-digit blocks.
constraints: Input contains digits, spaces, and dashes and has at least two digits.
Remove separators; emit groups of three, except a final four digits become two groups of two.
hints: Only the count of cleaned remaining digits determines the next block size.
Take groups of three while more than four remain; split exactly four as two plus two.
Strip non-digits, consume leading triples, handle the final two, three, or four digits, and join with dashes.
The stopping rule prevents a one-digit final block and all produced groups satisfy the required sizes.
editorial: The stopping rule prevents a one-digit final block and all produced groups satisfy the required sizes.

tests.explanation: Digits 123456 split into two groups of three: 123-456.
The final four digits split into 12 and 34 after the first group, producing 123-45-67.
